packages.name: @prometheus-ags/a2ui-react
packages.role: A2UI v1.0-RC compatibility for React over the official renderer, with policy-gated entity graph actions and AG-UI 0.0.59 activity support.

packages.name: @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-a2a
packages.role: Policy-gated A2A v1 JSON-RPC and streaming SSE for the Prometheus entity graph, with deterministic A2UI artifacts.

packages.name: @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-alpine
packages.role: Alpine.js plugin exposing $entity(type,id) and $entityList(type,query) magics — wires @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-core into Alpine.effect().

packages.name: @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-core
packages.role: Framework-agnostic normalized entity graph store (zero React) — the core of the Prometheus entity-graph ecosystem.

packages.name: @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-htmx
packages.role: Node.js SSE fragment server for HTMX — streams HTML entity fragments over Server-Sent Events with idiomorph/morph swaps, backed by the Prometheus entity graph.

packages.name: @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-react
packages.role: Normalized, globally-reactive entity graph store for React — the React bindings over @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-core. Re-exports the full core surface plus React hooks, CRUD, UI, and devtools.

packages.name: @prometheus-ags/prometheus-entity-management
packages.role: Compatibility alias for @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-react. The React bindings publish under that name; this package re-exports them so existing installs keep resolving.

packages.name: @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-sdl
packages.role: Schema Definition Language (SDL) for the entity graph — the shared contract every code generator (Rust CLI, Flutter, framework bindings) consumes.

packages.name: @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-solid
packages.role: SolidJS bindings for @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-core — fine-grained reactive entity and list primitives over the normalized entity graph.

packages.name: @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-svelte
packages.role: Svelte 5 runes bindings for the Prometheus entity graph — reactive $state stores that subscribe to the core graph.

packages.name: @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-sync
packages.role: Pluggable peer-sync providers for the entity graph — ships Yjs (WebSocket + WebRTC) and Loro CRDT providers that bridge the core entity graph with collaborative editing engines.

packages.name: @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-tauri
packages.role: Tauri v2 entity-graph plugin with generated TypeScript bindings, least-privilege capabilities, and bundled Rust, Android, and iOS sources.

packages.name: @prometheus-ags/entity-graph-web-components
packages.role: Lit 3 custom elements (<entity-list>, <entity-detail>, <entity-form>) using ReactiveController to subscribe to the core entity graph. Framework-agnostic.
